title: Reusing Retired Field Tag Numbers
pattern: Removing a deprecated field from a binary serialization schema and reassigning its unique tag ID to a new field with a different semantic meaning or type.
why_bad: Legacy database records or older running binaries will attempt to deserialize tag 2. Older binaries will decode the new transaction amount as `legacy_card_hash`, and newer binaries will crash or silently corrupt data when attempting to parse the legacy card hash string as an `int64` integer [632].
detection: Static analysis of schema file history detecting tag ID reassignment to different field names or data types.
counterexample: None. Tag reuse is always a defect in binary-encoded backwards-compatible schemas.
source: Designing Data-Intensive Applications, Chapter 4, "Protobuf / Thrift / Avro compatibility" [632]
